messages:
Aj_Support: quick escalation — NeptuneAI trial customer hitting onboarding friction. Provisioning finished but invite emails never reached admin users. Support ticket #74321. Trial days left: 6. Risk: renewal if they can't demo flows to execs. Asking CS to own comms and prioritization.
Maria_CSM: on it. can you paste the ticket link and the logs? also any VOC from the customer? :eyes:
Aj_Support: ticket: https://redwood-support/74321. logs show SMTP 250 accepted from our side but bounce X-Message-Delivery: deferred on recipient side. Customer says their infra blocks external invites. They tried manual resend, still not arriving.
Devon_ENG: we see the invites queued -> delivered to their MX, then 421 temporary deferred. Could be greylisting or internal spam filters. No error in our DKIM/SPF.
Maria_CSM: thanks. @Kai_CSM can you take lead on outreach? Recommend: (1) immediate email to primary admin from CSM with step-by-step bypass (org admin invite link), (2) schedule an enablement session before trial ends, (3) offer a temporary sandbox API key and expanded quota so they can demo.
Kai_CSM: I can do the outreach. Drafting message now. want to align with Support wording. Also recommend we CC Sales because exec demo is in flight.
Aj_Support: sharing suggested language snippet: \n```\nHi <AdminName>,\nWe noticed invite emails are being deferred by your mail provider. As a workaround you can add no-reply@redwood.ai to your allowlist or use this one-click admin invite link: https://app.redwood.ai/invite/neo-<token> (expires 48h). If you'd like, we can join a quick setup call to walk through SSO or invite flow.\nBest, Aj (Support)\n```\nMaria_CSM: good. Kai — propose reaching out now and locking a slot for enablement within 48h. I'll propose the sandbox key and quota bump (PM cleared) + capture VOC in Gainsight note.
Kai_CSM: outreach sent to primary admin + copied AE. included workaround link and offered 1-hr enablement slot tomorrow 10am PT. awaiting reply. :sent:
oncall-bot: ticket #74321 status changed -> escalated to CS. SLA: 24h.
Aj_Support: customer replied — they found the invite in spam folder. They accepted but asked for a short walkthrough focused on SSO mapping and role provisioning for demos.
Maria_CSM: schedule confirmed for 10am PT tomorrow. Kai and Devon — can you join to cover SSO and role mapping? Also I'll log renewal risk as 'watch' not 'at-risk' but mark for 1-week follow-up.
Devon_ENG: can join. quick checklist for the call: 1) verify SAML attributes, 2) test role provisioning via SCIM, 3) share one-click admin invite procedures. I'll prepare a short runbook.
Maria_CSM: perfect. After the call we'll send a follow-up summary + feedback capture form. CS action items: outreach (Kai), run enablement (Maria/Kai/Devon), update Gainsight and AE, confirm sandbox key applied (PM). Support action items: monitor ticket and keep logs attached.
Kai_CSM: noted. I'll paste the outreach thread into the customer record and tag AE for renewal play. :thumbsup:
Maria_CSM: thanks everyone. leaning on this being low-friction now but flagged due to tight trial timeline. I'll set a reminder for 1-week renewal check-in.
Aj_Support: thanks team. closing this slack thread — will update if anything changes.
